result.summary: The page is a food delivery app home screen that appears mostly functional. Found 3 minor to major issues related to layout and duplicate content.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' section shows two identical 'Green Bowl Poké' entries with the same image, delivery fee (€0.90), and time estimate (15-25 min), which appears to be duplicate content or a data error.
issues.suggestion: Verify the data source to ensure distinct restaurants are shown, or remove the duplicate entry if it is unintentional.

issues.description: The horizontal 'Fastest near you' cards are cut off on the right edge (Smash Bros Burger card and its text 'Smash Bros Bu...' are truncated), which is expected for a scroll carousel but may be unclear to users.
issues.suggestion: Ensure a visual affordance (partial card visibility is present) or add a subtle scroll indicator so users know they can swipe for more.

issues.description: The bottom pizza card in 'Popular right now' is partially cut off by the fixed bottom navigation bar, leaving its title and details hidden.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable content so cards are not obscured by the fixed navigation bar.
